$comment: The constants of the v2 ROS. Byte-identical on every episode, client, and scope. Rendered verbatim - never regenerated. NOTHING substitutes into any of them: {topic_phrase} moved out of `welcome` on 2026-08-18 when the string shrank to Introduction line 1. {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens are resolved downstream by pod-3B-client-ros, not here. Read by steps/04-segment-1.md and gated by steps/08-qa.md.

welcome.changed: 2026-08-18 - shrunk to sentence one. It used to swallow introduction line 2 ("I'm {{INTERVIEWER}}, and today we are talking about {topic_phrase}"), which froze the turn verb that introduction.md's ten line-2 patterns exist to vary, and made the live doc's four separate Introduction paragraphs impossible to render. Line 2 is GENERATED, carried in the payload as segment_1.setup. Line 1 stays STATIC because it is the sonic marker.
welcome.note: Line 1 only. The generated setup is line 2 and is not part of this constant.

welcome_first.when: Episode 1 only - the launch episode. There is no 'back' to welcome anyone to yet.
welcome_first.note: Episode 1 also drops {topic_phrase} from line 1; the launch setup happens in line 2. Same shrink applies: line 1 only.

welcome_embedded.when: FALLBACK ONLY (Gabe, 2026-08-26, locked later the same day): fires when the podcast name embeds the attorney's name with NO 'w./with' to split at (e.g. 'The Robert May Show'). A name of the shape '{Prefix} w./with {Attorney}' takes the SPLIT SPOKEN form instead - see `welcome_split_rule`.
welcome_embedded.changed: 2026-08-26 - added per Gabe as the primary embedded form ('the {{PODCAST_NAME}} Podcast.' instead of 'with **{{ATTORNEY_NAME}}**', which doubles the name). Superseded LATER THE SAME DAY as primary: 'the Car Accident Attorney w. Robert May Podcast' jams three names into one breath, so w./with names now SPLIT (see `welcome_split_rule`, mirrored from ce-ros-v2 assemble.ts). This constant survives as the no-splice fallback.
welcome_embedded.note: Line 1 only, same shrink as `welcome`. A 'w.' in the podcast name is spoken, and rendered in the welcome, as 'with' - see `spoken_forms`.

welcome_embedded_first.when: Episode 1 only, same FALLBACK-ONLY status as `welcome_embedded`. Same rule as `welcome_first`: there is no 'back' on a launch episode.
welcome_embedded_first.note: Line 1 only. Same embedded-name precedence as `welcome_embedded` (Gabe, 2026-08-26).

spoken_forms.$comment: Gabe, 2026-08-26. Abbreviations inside a podcast name resolve to their spoken form wherever the name is spoken, and in the rendered welcome line.

welcome_split_rule.$comment: Gabe, 2026-08-26, LOCKED. Line 1 precedence, mirrored from ce-ros-v2 src/lib/run-of-show-v2/generation/assemble.ts (spokenShowParts + pickWelcome): (1) podcast name matches '{Prefix} w./with {Attorney}' -> the SPLIT SPOKEN form, computed at populate, PLAIN TEXT with NO bolds: 'Welcome back to the {Prefix} podcast with {Attorney}.' (Episode 1 opens 'Welcome to'). The attorney is said once and 'podcast' sits in the middle. (2) name otherwise embeds the attorney's full or last name -> the `welcome_embedded` / `welcome_embedded_first` constants. (3) otherwise -> `welcome` / `welcome_first`. Display contexts keep the stored name untouched; the split is spoken-form only.
welcome_split_rule.example: Car Accident Attorney w. Robert May -> Welcome back to the Car Accident Attorney podcast with Robert May.

speaker_tags.$comment: One tag left. The `interviewer` tag was cut 2026-08-18 - from the Introduction, where the welcome already makes the speaker obvious, and from the outro, where outro_note already says who is speaking. It is preserved under `retired` so a future edit does not reintroduce it believing it was lost by accident.

retired.$comment: Cut from the format on 2026-08-17, plus the interviewer speaker tag on 2026-08-18. Listed so a future edit does not reintroduce them believing they were lost by accident.
retired.handoff: Then turn it over and let them run.
retired.after_prompt: Then stop talking. Do not narrow it or offer an example to start them. The silence is the format.
retired.answer_intro: Three moves, in this order. A shape, not a script.
retired.move_2: What they need to know right now...
retired.attr_intro: What people are actually trying to find out before they call anyone...
retired.attr_sources_internal: Source consistency, from live Google AI Overview and ChatGPT pulls...
retired.shortform_mode: Mode switch, and say it on mic...
retired.shortform_sets: Ten questions per set, one set per location...
retired.speaker_tag_interviewer: INTERVIEWER - cut 2026-08-18 from both the Introduction and the Outro. ATTORNEY RESPONSE in the Introduction is the only speaker tag left.

_moved_2026-08-18: outro_thanks, outro_signoff, outro_reach and outro_praise are no longer constants. See references/outro-banks.json and references/outro.md. The STATIC set is now THREE strings: welcome, welcome_first, outro_note.
_removed_2026-08-21: outro_note removed per Gabe. The STATIC set is now TWO strings: welcome / welcome_first. The outro renders as the three generated spoken lines only, with no host direction above them.
_added_2026-08-26: welcome_embedded and welcome_embedded_first added per Gabe, for podcast names that embed the attorney's name. The STATIC set is now FOUR strings: welcome / welcome_first / welcome_embedded / welcome_embedded_first. Exactly one welcome fires per episode, decided by episode number and the `welcome_split_rule` precedence - and for '{Prefix} w./with {Attorney}' names the fired line is the computed SPLIT form, not any constant (Gabe, 2026-08-26, locked).
